sinks.description: Google BigQuery — one table per stream, atomic overwrite or keyed MERGE upsert
sinks.name: bigquery

params.description: Dataset every stream's table lands in
params.name: bq_dataset

params.description: GCP project id that owns the dataset
params.name: bq_project

params.description: Service-account key JSON, inline. Pass it with --param-env from a secret store; copy this template and switch `auth` to application_default to use ADC instead.
params.name: bq_sa_key

sinks.description: Local JSON Lines files, one per stream — the local validation destination
sinks.name: jsonl

params.description: Directory to write <source>/<stream>.jsonl under
params.name: out_dir

sinks.description: PostgreSQL — one auto-mapped table per stream, transactional overwrite or ON CONFLICT upsert
sinks.name: postgres

params.description: Schema every stream's table is created in
params.name: pg_schema

params.description: postgres://user:pass@host:5432/db connection URL
params.name: pg_url

sinks.description: Local SQLite database — one auto-mapped table per stream, real overwrite/upsert semantics without infrastructure
sinks.name: sqlite

params.description: Database file (created if missing)
params.name: sqlite_path

sources.description: Example — two CSV exports as two streams (runs offline, no credentials)
sources.name: example-csv

params.description: Directory holding orders.csv and customers.csv
params.name: data_dir

sources.description: Example — a bearer-authenticated REST API with cursor pagination and one stream per endpoint
sources.name: example-rest-api

params.description: Bearer token
params.name: api_token

params.description: API root, e.g. https://api.example.com/v1
params.name: base_url

sources.description: GitHub REST API (2026-03-10) — one repository's issues, pull requests, comments, commits, releases and workflow runs
sources.name: github

params.description: REST API root; https://HOST/api/v3 for GitHub Enterprise Server
params.name: github_api_url

params.description: Repository owner (user or organization login)
params.name: github_owner

params.description: Repository name
params.name: github_repo

params.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the incremental streams start from on their first run
params.name: github_start_date

params.description: Fine-grained personal access token or GitHub App installation token with read access to Metadata, Contents, Issues, Pull requests and Actions on the repository
params.name: github_token

sources.description: Google Ads API v25 (GAQL search) — account, campaigns, ad groups, ads, keywords and daily performance reports
sources.name: google-ads

params.description: Google Ads API root
params.name: google_ads_api_url

params.description: Customer id of the account to read, digits only (1234567890)
params.name: google_ads_customer_id

params.description: GAQL condition on segments.date for the performance streams — a rolling window (`DURING LAST_30_DAYS`) or a backfill range (`BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'`)
params.name: google_ads_date_filter

params.description: Developer token from the manager account's API Center
params.name: google_ads_developer_token

params.description: Customer id of the manager account you authenticate through, digits only; the account's own id when you have direct access
params.name: google_ads_login_customer_id

params.description: OAuth 2.0 client id (Google Cloud project)
params.name: google_client_id

params.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret
params.name: google_client_secret

params.description: OAuth 2.0 refresh token for a user with access to the account (scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/adwords)
params.name: google_refresh_token

params.description: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint
params.name: google_token_uri

sources.description: Google Analytics 4 Data API v1beta (runReport) — daily traffic, sources, landing pages, pages, events, devices and geography
sources.name: google-analytics-4

params.description: Data API root
params.name: ga4_api_url

params.description: Days re-read before the bookmark on every run — GA4 keeps processing a day for 24-48 hours
params.name: ga4_lookback_days

params.description: Rows per runReport page (1-250000)
params.name: ga4_page_size

params.description: Numeric GA4 property id (Admin → Property details)
params.name: ga4_property_id

params.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD) read when no bookmark is stored
params.name: ga4_start_date

params.description: Days per runReport request window
params.name: ga4_window_days

params.description: Service-account key JSON, inline. Add the service account's email to the property as a Viewer
params.name: google_sa_key

params.description: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint the service-account assertion is exchanged at
params.name: google_token_uri

sources.description: HubSpot CRM — contacts, companies, deals, tickets (incremental on last-modified, archived records as delete markers), owners, deal and ticket pipelines
sources.name: hubspot

params.description: API root; override only for replay tests
params.name: api_base_url

params.description: Access token of a private app (or app static token) holding the read scopes listed in hubspot.md
params.name: hubspot_access_token

params.description: Records per search request (the search API's maximum is 200)
params.name: hubspot_page_size

params.description: RFC 3339 lower bound on last-modified for the first run (default: every record)
params.name: hubspot_start_date

sources.description: Jira Cloud — issues (all fields), projects, users, fields, statuses, issue types, priorities, resolutions
sources.name: jira

params.description: Atlassian API token (id.atlassian.com → Security → API tokens)
params.name: jira_api_token

params.description: Atlassian account email the API token belongs to
params.name: jira_email

params.description: Your site's root, https://<site>.atlassian.net
params.name: jira_url

sources.description: Meta Marketing API v25.0 — ad account, campaigns, ad sets, ads, creatives and daily Insights (async report runs)
sources.name: meta-ads

params.description: System-user (or user) access token with the ads_read permission on the ad account
params.name: meta_access_token

params.description: Ad account id, digits only (the part after act_)
params.name: meta_ad_account_id

params.description: Graph API root
params.name: meta_graph_url

params.description: Insights window re-read every run; Insights stop changing 28 days after they are reported, so last_28d re-reads every day that can still move
params.name: meta_insights_date_preset

sources.description: Salesforce — accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, line items, users, campaigns, campaign members, cases, tasks and events via Bulk API 2.0, incremental on SystemModstamp with soft deletes
sources.name: salesforce

params.description: REST API version the jobs are created with
params.name: salesforce_api_version

params.description: Consumer key of an external client app (or connected app) with the client credentials flow enabled
params.name: salesforce_client_id

params.description: Consumer secret of that app
params.name: salesforce_client_secret

params.description: Your org's My Domain URL, https://<mydomain>.my.salesforce.com
params.name: salesforce_url

sources.description: Shopify GraphQL Admin API (2026-07) — orders, customers, products, variants, collections, locations and product deletions
sources.name: shopify

params.description: Client id of an app from the Dev Dashboard installed on the store (same organization)
params.name: shopify_client_id

params.description: Client secret of that app
params.name: shopify_client_secret

params.description: The store's admin URL, https://<store>.myshopify.com
params.name: shopify_shop_url

params.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the incremental streams start from on their first run
params.name: shopify_start_date

sources.description: Stripe — customers, subscriptions, invoices, charges, refunds, payment intents, products, prices, payouts, disputes, balance transactions and events
sources.name: stripe

params.description: API root; override only for replay tests
params.name: api_base_url

params.description: Restricted API key (rk_live_…) with Read access to the resources below, or a secret key (sk_live_…)
params.name: stripe_api_key

params.description: Stripe-Version header pinning the response shape (https://docs.stripe.com/api/versioning)
params.name: stripe_api_version

params.description: RFC 3339 lower bound for the first run of the created-windowed streams (balance_transactions, events)
params.name: stripe_start_date

sources.description: Zendesk Support — tickets and users (incremental exports, deletes included), organizations, groups, ticket fields, ticket metrics, satisfaction ratings
sources.name: zendesk

params.description: API token (Admin Center → Apps and integrations → Zendesk API)
params.name: zendesk_api_token

params.description: Email of the admin whose API token is used
params.name: zendesk_email

params.description: Unix time (seconds) the first incremental export starts from (default 2000-01-01, i.e. everything)
params.name: zendesk_start_time

params.description: Your account's API root, https://<subdomain>.zendesk.com
params.name: zendesk_url
